description: This file contains functions and methods related to initializing and managing templates within the focalboard application, including importing default templates, checking if initialization is needed, and fixing template blocks and boards.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct that manages templates and store interactions.

methods.name: initializeTemplates
methods.description: Imports default templates if the boards table is empty or contains outdated templates.

methods.name: isInitializationNeeded
methods.description: Checks whether template initialization is required based on existing boards.

methods.name: fixTemplateBlock
methods.description: Adjusts a block to be inserted as part of a template, skipping certain blocks based on cache.

methods.name: fixTemplateBoard
methods.description: Adjusts a board to be inserted as part of a template, filtering out non-template boards and setting properties.
